step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows content ingest, archive, processing, and distribution. A third-party content supplier ingests raw files into an Ingest S3 bucket. The content is moved to an Archive S3 bucket and triggers events via Lambda to an EC2 Processing fleet. The fleet processes media assets from Archive and deposits final assets into a Distribution S3 bucket, which delivers them to consumers on TV devices. A Security box (KMS) sits at the top providing access control and encryption keys.
